punchline: A chimpanzee will not trade a banana for a promise of bananas in chimpanzee heaven, but people trade for shared stories every day.
thirty_sec: Harari says you could never persuade a chimpanzee to give up a banana for the promise of endless bananas in chimpanzee heaven. Humans do this constantly. A company like Peugeot has no body, yet the law treats it as a person that can own property, borrow money and be sued. Money, nations and rights work the same way: they hold because enough of us agree they are real.
